description: This file defines an interface for representing and manipulating JSON pointers within a Java project. It includes methods for parsing, constructing, and navigating JSON paths, and handles deep hierarchies within JSON objects.

classes.name: JsonPointer
classes.description: An interface representing a hierarchical path within a JSON object, immutable, providing methods to parse, extend, and traverse JSON paths.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns an empty JSON pointer represented by '/' using the JsonFactory.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Parses a slash-delimited string into a JsonPointer, supporting escape sequences for special characters.

methods.name: addLeaf
methods.description: Creates a new JsonPointer by adding a JSON key as the last element.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends another JsonPointer to the current pointer, forming a combined path.

methods.name: getLevelCount
methods.description: Returns the number of hierarchical levels in the pointer.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Indicates whether the pointer contains any elements.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the JSON key at a specified hierarchical level.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the root JSON key of the pointer.

methods.name: getLeaf
methods.description: Returns the leaf JSON key of the pointer.

methods.name: cutLeaf
methods.description: Removes the last element from the pointer, returning a new pointer.

methods.name: nextLevel
methods.description: Moves to the next sub-level of the current pointer.

methods.name: getSubPointer
methods.description: Returns a sub-path including all elements from a specified level to the end.

methods.name: getPrefixPointer
methods.description: Returns a sub-path from the root up to a specified level.

methods.name: toFieldSelector
methods.description: Converts this pointer into a JsonFieldSelector containing this pointer.
